name: Reutte
kurzbeschreibung: Innsbruck, the main town of the Außerfern, is home to the Highline179 suspension bridge and Schloss Ehrenberg.
beschreibung:
Überblick

Reutte is situated in north-western Tyrol within the broad Außerfern basin along the wild Lech River at an elevation of 853 metres, home to around 7,420 residents. Framed by the Lechtal, Allgäu, and Ammergau Alps, Reutte serves as the administrative, cultural, and economic capital of the district. Having held market rights since 1489, Reutte was officially designated a city municipality in May 2024. The townscape features grand historic merchant houses adorned with ornate trompe-l'œil facade murals (Lüftlmalerei). Reutte harmoniously combines untamed alpine river environments with monument-rich medieval castle ruins and modern leisure infrastructure.

Geschichte

Reutte was first documented in 1278 as Reutin, designating land cleared from forest. Duke Sigmund the Wealthy elevated the settlement to a market town on 5 June 1489. Reutte grew wealthy through its pivotal location along historic trade routes, including the Roman Via Claudia Augusta and the Via Salina salt trail leading from Hall in Tirol across the Fern Pass towards Lake Constance. Beginning in 1290, Count Meinhard II of Tyrol founded the monumental Ehrenberg Castle ensemble to defend Tyrol against Bavarian invasions. The complex comprises the Gothic Ehrenberg ruins, the fortified Klause valley barrier, Fort Claudia, and Schlosskopf fortress. In the town centre, the Museum im Grünen Haus, a 16th-century patrician residence painted with vibrant green facade art by Johann Jakob Zeiller in 1779, celebrates local history and art.

Anreise

Reutte offers seamless accessibility by road and rail. By car, travellers arriving from Germany can reach the city vignette-free via the A7 motorway and the Füssen border tunnel along the B179 Fernpassstraße in roughly 15 minutes. From the south, the B179 crosses the scenic Fern Pass from the Inntalautobahn A12. Train passengers arrive along the cross-border Außerfernbahn railway line, with direct hourly services operating from Kempten im Allgäu as well as Munich and Garmisch-Partenkirchen to Reutte in Tirol railway station. VVT regional buses connect the station to surrounding valleys.

Tipps

A premier attraction is the world-famous highline179 suspension bridge, stretching 406 metres across the valley at a dizzying height of 114 metres to connect the Ehrenberg ruins with Fort Claudia. At the Burgenwelt Ehrenberg museum complex, visitors explore medieval armoury exhibits and ride the inclined Ehrenberg Liner elevator. The Alpentherme Ehrenberg spa offers thermal brine pools, lazy rivers, and award-winning saunas with direct fortress views. Nature lovers should hike along the gravel banks of the Tiroler Lech Nature Park or take a scenic boat cruise across fjord-like Lake Plansee, while the Hahnenkammbahn cable car in nearby Höfen provides year-round alpine sports.
